description: RYOBI introduces the USB Lithium Power Scrubber Kit, the ultimate solution for powerful cleaning in a compact size. With 2 speeds settings, and a MAX of 300 RPM, you'll enjoy improved cleaning efficiency that helps you tackle even the toughest cleaning jobs with ease. This scrubber is compatible with all RYOBI cleaning Hex Shank accessories: ranging from soft, medium, hard, and abrasive bristles as well as sponge and scour pads. The included 2" Medium Bristle Brush is ideal for cleaning tile, granite, fiberglass and more. Clean with confidence knowing the scrubber’s battery enclosure is IPX7 Water Resistance Rated, meaning this tool can be submerged in up to 3 feet of water for 30 minutes. This scrubber is lightweight and ergonomic for everyday cleaning. This product features an LED indicator to signal when the battery is charged (green) or has low battery (red) while in-use. Best of all, it is part of the RYOBI USB Lithium System of tools that provides compact, portable and rechargeable solutions for cordless power and productivity.
